Resolves #21751

`LinkClip.spec.mjs` now waits until links paint in the chart before it asks whether any paints in the locked columns. After a horizontal scroll the dependency layer redraws on its own schedule, so two equal frames could come before the links were back: run 44871811594 on #21732 failed the chart check, and the table check ahead of it had passed on an empty layer, which would also let a link painted over the table slip through.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e, 10 of 10 locally with `--repeat-each 5`) → L3 required (a browser spec). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — two checks reordered, the chart's polled.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The diff: `expect.poll(() => linksPaintIn(page, chart)).toBe(true)` runs before the table check in both cases (`gantt/zoom` 2400 px, `gantt/basic` 300 px) |
| AC-2 | Outside CI: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/gantt/LinkClip.spec.mjs --repeat-each 5`, 10 passed (29.2 s) on `dev` `07b6cbd213` |
